subject: Q1 OKR: charter draft, alignment notes, and QBR packet prep
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 4 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q1 OKR: charter draft, alignment notes, and QBR packet prep

Team —

Happy new year and quick kickoff note for Q1 OKRs. I uploaded a draft charter and a companion QBR packet template to the Drive link below. Goal here is to agree on the top 6 metrics that will be in the QBR and sign off on owner-level commitments by Friday so the GTM & Eng leads can finalize decks.

Attachments: Q1_2027_OKR_Charter_v0.9.docx (draft), QBR_Packet_Template_v1.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cQBR_root

Ask: please review the charter (section headings are: Mission Focus, Revenue/Usage Targets, Latency & Cost SLOs, Reliability/Availability, Expansion/Channels, Team-level Initiatives) and add comments inline by EOD Wed. I suggest we keep the top-level OKRs to 3-4 company goals and then 6 measurable KR buckets.

Notes: I captured a couple of open items — a) whether we keep the current 99.9% per-route latency SLO or bump to 99.95% for Dedicated customers, and b) whether optimization tooling (Redwood Optimize) is a product OKR or an infra initiative. Please flag any dependencies you’d like included.

I’ll collate comments and propose a sign-off runbook (owners + deadlines). We can decide whether to invite Sara Nelson from Acadia Health into the QBR prep review next week (they requested early visibility).

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 OKR: charter draft, alignment notes, and QBR packet prep

Thanks Jordan — looks good overall. Quick thoughts:
- Latency SLO: I’m inclined to keep 99.9% as company-wide but set a Dedicated tier 99.95% objective for enterprise customers (call it a contractable SLA, not the default product SLO).
- Optimize placement: product OKR for this quarter (we need go-to-market collateral). Engineering can own delivery workstreams, but Marketing + Product should drive a launch cadence.

I’ll add comments in the doc today. If we plan to invite Acadia, fine by me — they’re a high-priority customer for the Dedicated play.

Vivek
CEO, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 OKR: charter draft, alignment notes, and QBR packet prep

Jordan — I reviewed and left comments in two places: 1) Revenue KRs — we should split ARR motion vs. usage-based revenue so sales ops can track adoption; 2) QBR template — add a slide for "Operational Risks & Mitigations" (one-pager).

Also, suggest a short pre-QBR rehearsal with the executive panel on Jan 18th — 30 minutes to run the top metrics and callouts.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 OKR: charter draft, alignment notes, and QBR packet prep

Thanks for the comments — added a usage vs ARR breakdown into the charter and included an Operational Risks & Mitigations slide in the packet template (see attached "roadmap-notes-20270104.md").

Regarding rehearsal: Jan 18th works. I’ll schedule 30 minutes and circulate a 1-page runbook (who speaks which metric + 3 anticipated questions and escalation contacts).

Open item: owner assignments for the KRs. I propose the following owners for the company-level KRs:
- Growth (New logos & ARR): Lauren
- Activation & Core Usage: Karthik
- Reliability & Latency: Grace
- Cost per Token (efficiency): Product/Platform (TBD — I will nominate an engineering lead)

Please reply if any of these need to move. I plan to push an editable owner matrix by tomorrow morning.

Jordan

From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 15:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 OKR: charter draft, alignment notes, and QBR packet prep

Jordan — I accept Reliability & Latency as owner. One request: can we set a softer interim target for the public latency SLO (99.9%) with a parallel improvement KR: "Reduce p95 latency by 15% for hosted API"? That gives engineering a measurable win even if absolute SLO work is gated by infra capacity.

Also, I flagged the dependency on the Dedicated autoscaling policy in the doc — need a follow-up with infra on capacity planning by Jan 11.

—Grace
Director of Engineering, Reliability

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, sara.nelson@acadiahealth.com

Team — thanks for rapid turnaround and thoughtful notes. Summary / next steps: 
1) Owners: confirmed (Lauren, Karthik, Grace). I will nominate an engineering lead for Cost per Token by Monday.
2) Action items: comments in charter consolidated; Capacity planning follow-up (Grace) due Jan 11; Exec rehearsal Jan 18 10:00–10:30 PST — calendar invites forthcoming.
3) QBR Packet: finalized template attached. I gave Sara (Acadia Health) early visibility at her request — she asked to join the rehearsal to share a brief customer perspective. Sara, if you can join the Jan 18th rehearsal for 5–7 minutes, that would be great.

Attachments: QBR_Packet_Template_v1.pdf (final)

Please reply with explicit sign-off on owner assignments by EOD Monday; if no concerns, I’ll mark them as approved and circulate the owner matrix.

Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
